annotations.title: Packaging EPR tonnage and fee estimate

description: Total packaging weight by material from per-unit weights and units sold into a state, and estimate EPR fees from rates you enter from your producer responsibility organization's fee schedule. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

caSmall.description: California small producer threshold (gross annual sales under) (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for california small producer threshold (gross annual sales under). Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 1000000 USD from CalRecycle, Packaging EPR exemptions and exclusions page (SB 54), effective SB 54 program, page viewed 2026-11-09. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when exemption is ca; ignored otherwise.

components.description: Packaging components. One row per packaging component per product, such as a box, bottle, cap or label.

basis.description: Fee rate basis. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for fee rate basis. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: lb = Per pound; shortTon = Per short ton (2,000 lb); metricTon = Per metric ton (1,000 kg).

grams.description: Unit weight (g). Weight of this packaging component per unit sold, in grams.

label.description: Reference label (no names needed). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for reference label (no names needed). Unknown is not the same as zero. Optional reference label; no names or personal data.

material.description: Material category. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for material category. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: paper = Paper and fiber; plasticRigid = Plastic, rigid; plasticFlexible = Plastic, flexible; glass = Glass; aluminum = Metal, aluminum; steel = Metal, steel; wood = Wood; other = Other or composite.

rate.description: Fee rate from the fee schedule (your figure) (US dollars). Enter the rate for this material from your producer responsibility organization's current fee schedule; the example is illustrative.

units.description: Units sold into the state per year (units). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for units sold into the state per year. Unknown is not the same as zero.

exemption.description: Small-producer check. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for small-producer check. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: none = Skip; ca = California SB 54 small producer (reference).

grossSales.description: Your gross sales in California for the most recent calendar year (US dollars). SB 54 (Public Resources Code 42060(a)(5), as chaptered) exempts producers that had gross sales of less than $1,000,000 in the state in the most recent calendar year. CalRecycle’s page says only “gross annual sales”; check 14 CCR 18980.5.2 for how sales are counted (for example affiliates). Used only when exemption is ca; ignored otherwise.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_packaging_epr_tonnage_and_fee_estimate

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.
